description.value:
A high-capacity storage drive, equipped with an onboard organic-to-digital communication bus, is installed in your cerebral cortex, giving you access to additional information on a narrow topic. While you have the memory expansion installed, you become master in a single Lore skill, chosen when you install or improve the augmentation. Since this proficiency is temporary, you can't use it as a prerequisite for a skill increase or a permanent character option like a feat.

Activate—Solid State Memory 1 (concentrate, fortune)

Frequency once per day

Effect You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Recall Knowledge] using the Lore skill granted by this augmentation, rolling the skill check twice and taking the higher result. The question must be relevant to the chosen skill.

Special If you have a datajack augmentation, a single memory expansion you have installed doesn't count toward your implant limit. Further memory expansions still count.
